claims.claim: The Konica Minolta Bizhub Pro C754e is a large, full colour, laser multifunctional printer.
claims.evidence: Witness report identifies the machine as Konica Minolta bizhub PRO C754e and describes it as a large office multifunction copier/printer with scanner bed and paper output tray.
Witness report does not show a meter/page counter or any usage readout.

claims.claim: New drum and toner just fitted.
claims.evidence: Witness report shows protective wrapping but does not show toner/drum labels, dates, or a consumables status screen.
Witness report shows no evidence of a test run or error/jam indicators; no jam status is shown.

risks.risk: Unknown working condition (no power-on, no print/copy test shown).
risks.proof: A short video/clip showing the machine powering on, reaching the home screen, and producing a test print/copy (with no error/jam message).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst case: may need service/repair).

risks.risk: Page count may be higher than claimed (meter not shown).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the internal counter/page meter screen (or service counter) showing total prints/copies.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case usage (treat as higher wear).

risks.risk: Consumables may not be truly new or may be near end-of-life (toner/drum status not shown).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of toner/drum units with labels and/or a screen showing consumables levels/status.
risks.if_unproven: Price without assuming fresh consumables (treat as needing replacement soon).

risks.risk: Hidden faults like jams, fuser issues, or worn rollers (no error codes shown).
risks.proof: A clip showing a successful multi-page test print and a check of the machine’s error/history screen (if available).
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially fault-prone (worst case: service required).

risks.risk: Missing trays/parts or incorrect paper configuration (tray contents/capacity not shown).
risks.proof: Photos showing all installed trays (including any optional trays) with paper size labels, and a screen confirming paper settings.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming incomplete/unknown configuration (worst case: missing parts).

risks.proof: A photo of the rear/side ports (USB/Ethernet/Wi‑Fi module if present) plus a clip showing it connected and printing from a laptop/PC.
risks.if_unproven: Price as requiring setup/driver work (worst case: connectivity not ready).

proof_requests: Photo of the page counter/meter screen showing total copies/prints.
Photo(s) of toner and drum units (labels) and/or a consumables status screen with levels.
Video clip: power on → home screen → run a short test print/copy (showing no jam/error).
Photo/video of any error/history screen (or confirmation that none exist).
Photos of all paper trays installed and their paper size settings/labels.
Photo of rear/side connectivity ports and a quick demonstration of printing from a laptop/PC.
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies the exact model (Konica Minolta bizhub PRO C754e) and the item type, so it can be priced at its worst-case condition. Seller claims about page count, new consumables, and no jams are not verifiable from the provided report, so pricing should assume the least favorable scenario until proof is provided.
